∀ (h hθ : ℝ → ℝ) (θ h1 h2 : ℝ),
  HasDerivAt h h1 θ →
    HasDerivAt hθ h2 θ →
      hθ θ = h1 →
        HasDerivAt (BfgsVerification.PlanarTransport.angularFrame h hθ)
          ((h θ + h2) • BfgsVerification.PlanarTransport.tangent θ) θ

∀ (θ sT sn a b e : ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.HomogeneousPlanar.pairDet
      (sT • BfgsVerification.PlanarTransport.tangent θ + sn • BfgsVerification.PlanarTransport.normal θ)
      ((a * sT + b * sn) • BfgsVerification.PlanarTransport.tangent θ +
        (e * sn) • BfgsVerification.PlanarTransport.normal θ) =
    sn * ((a - e) * sT + b * sn)

∀ {n : ℕ} {F : BfgsVerification.Vec n → ℝ} (R : BfgsVerification.AdmissibleBFGSRun n F) {r : ℕ} (k : ℕ)
  (V W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin r) ℝ) (T : BfgsVerification.Mat r) (b : BfgsVerification.Vec r),
  W = V * T + BfgsVerification.EnergyIdentities.rectOuter (R.displacement k) b →
    BfgsVerification.metricGram (R.hessian (k + 1)) W =
      Matrix.transpose T *
            (BfgsVerification.metricGram (R.hessian k) V -
              (R.q k)⁻¹ • BfgsVerification.outer (V.transpose.mulVec (R.g k)) (V.transpose.mulVec (R.g k))) *
          T +
        (R.curvature k)⁻¹ •
          BfgsVerification.outer (W.transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k)) (W.transpose.mulVec (R.gradientChange k))
